message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What you need | How it works | |---------|---------------|--------------| | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue). Each color has numbers 0‑9 (two of each except one 0) and two of each action card: Skip, Reverse, Draw Two. Plus 4 Wild cards and 4 Wild Draw Four cards. | Shuffle the deck and deal 7 cards to each player. Place the remaining cards face‑down to form the draw pile. Turn the top card face‑up to start the discard pile. | | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or a pre‑agreed total). Points are tallied at the end of each round. | | **Gameplay** | 1. Play proceeds clockwise (unless a Reverse changes direction). 2. On your turn, you may play **one** card that matches either the color, number, or symbol of the top discard. 3. If you cannot play, you must draw one card from the draw pile. If that card can be played, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Action Cards** | • **Skip** – next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – changes play direction.
• **Draw Two** – next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Wild** – you choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – you choose the new color; next player draws four cards and loses their turn. | | **Wild Draw Four Rules** | You may only play a Wild Draw Four if you have no other playable card. If a player who was forced to draw four believes you broke this rule, they can challenge you:
• If you were caught lying, you must draw six cards (instead of four).
• If you were honest, the challenger draws four cards. | | **Calling “Uno”** | When you play your second‑to‑last card, shout “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. If you forget and another player catches you, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards all their cards. That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of the cards left in opponents’ hands: numbers = face value, action cards = 20, Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50. | | **Scoring** | Add the round score to the winner’s total. Play continues until someone reaches the target score. | | **Variations** | • **House Rules** – e.g., “Draw Two” can be stacked, “Wild Draw Four” can be played on any card, etc.
• **Speed Uno** – no drawing; play as fast as possible.
• **Uno Attack** – use a special card‑shuffling machine. | --- ### Quick Play‑through 1. **Setup**: Shuffle, deal 7 cards each, flip top card to start discard pile. 2. **Turn**: Match color/number/symbol or play a Wild. If you can’t, draw one card. 3. **Action**: Follow the effect of any action card. 4. **UNO**: Say “UNO” when you’re down to one card. 5. **Finish**: Discard last card → round ends → score. Enjoy! 🎉
